name: Ranger Capsule 18
about: Ranger Capsule 18 (1962 B ETA, NASA/JPL), launched 1962 Oct 18. Its phases from GCAT: Luna, Earth, HCO. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.
